meta.promptText: Mujhe India mein 3000 rupees ke andar running shoes kharidne hain. Konse lene chahiye?

response.text:
Bharat mein 3,000 rupees ke budget mein running shoes ke liye kai behtareen aur durable options available hain. Is price range mein aapko comfort, cushioning, aur grip achhi mil jayegi jo daily running aur walking ke liye perfect hain.

Neeche kuch best running shoes ki list di gayi hai jo is budget mein aate hain:

---

### Best Running Shoes Under ₹3,000 in India

| Brand & Model | Key Features | Best For | Estimated Price |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Campus OGs / Camp-GLO** | Lightweight, breathable mesh, great cushioning | Daily jogging & gym | ₹1,200 - ₹2,000 |
| **Sparx SX0141G / Running Shoes** | Durable sole, strong grip, tough built | Rough usage & regular road running | ₹1,000 - ₹1,800 |
| **Asian Thunder / Ignite Series** | Memory foam insole, highly comfortable, stylish | Casual running & walking | ₹900 - ₹1,500 |
| **Red Tape Sports Shoes** | Premium look, good ankle support, value for money | Daily wear & light running | ₹1,500 - ₹2,500 *(on sale)* |
| **Puma / Bata (Entry-level)** | Brand reliability, decent cushioning | Short distance running | ₹2,200 - ₹3,000 *(during sales)* |

---

### 💡 Tips Khareedne Se Pehle:

* **Size:** Running shoes hamesha apne normal shoe size se **1 size bada** kharidein, kyunki daudte waqt pair thode phoolte hain aur aage jagah honi chahiye.
* **Online Sales:** Agar aap thoda wait kar sakte hain ya Flipkart/Amazon par sales (jaise Big Billion Days ya Great Indian Festival) ka use karein, toh aapko **Puma, Adidas, ya Reebok** ke entry-level running shoes bhi ₹2,500 - ₹3,000 ki range mein mil sakte hain.

Aapka main use kya hai (jaise daily running, gym, ya sirf walking)? Aur agar aapka koi preferred brand ho toh batayein, taaki main aur specific option bata sakoon.
